topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The lines on my skin, they speak of me, of my journey, my trials. Someone saw them and felt compelled to etch them anew, to carry a piece of my story. These marks, each one a silent roar, now resonate beyond my flesh. They saw the depth, the swirls of my existence, and deemed it worthy to echo through their own canvas. A bond, unseen yet unbreakable, forms between us, a silent pact in the dance of life. These tattoos, they were mine, and now, they transcend, a testament to what resonates within us all.
